# SteadyFocusCo

SteadyFocusCo provides ADHD-friendly planners, printables, checklists, and free productivity tools designed to reduce overwhelm, improve focus, and make planning easier.

## What the site provides

- ADHD-friendly planners and printables
- Productivity and executive-function tools
- Free interactive tools (no sign-up required)
- Practical guides on ADHD planning, study skills, and routines
- A shop with printable planners (purchases handled on Etsy)

## Shop

Printable planners are sold through the SteadyFocusCo Etsy shop. The site links to Etsy for all purchases; SteadyFocusCo never processes payments directly.
